title: Four Seasons
drawAria: Turn one card from the stock

frontendHint.fourseasonsWaste: The waste card can be played to a corner
frontendHint.fourseasonsTableau: A cross pile top can be played to a corner

tutorial.baseRank: This deal's base rank. All four corner foundations start here — not necessarily at an Ace.
tutorial.foundations: The four corner foundations. They build up in suit, and wrap: an Ace follows a King.
tutorial.cross: The five cross piles. They build down ignoring suit, and wrap: a King goes under an Ace. Only the top card moves, and an emptied space accepts any card.
tutorial.controls: Controls: draw, hint, undo and more.
